intent: Create a welcoming madowaku portal where hand-drawn windows can be opened to reveal different small game and creative project rooms. Preserve a warm imperfect hand-made feeling rather than a glossy SaaS dashboard.
must_keep: Clickable windows are meaningful native controls, not a flattened background image.
Keep deliberately irregular pixel-art and painterly edges where they carry character.
Respect existing MADO creative direction, approved assets, and project architecture.
Remain usable with keyboard, touch, reduced motion and mobile viewports.
interactions: Activate a window with pointer or keyboard and open its content.
Close an opened window and restore focus to its trigger.
Honor reduced-motion settings in open and close transitions.
